# vpsie_file_share (Resource)

An NFS file share served inside a VPC. Creating, growing, shrinking and deleting run on the platform, so each waits until the share is ready (or gone) before it returns. Creating and growing need the `fileStorage` licence module and quota; reading, changing access, shrinking and deleting never do. Deleting refuses a share that still has an import running and removes it only when the share is not in use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_file_share" "data" {
  name          = "data"
  dc_identifier = "replace-with-datacenter-identifier"
  vpc_id        = 42
  size_gb       = 100

  access = [
    {
      cidr = "10.0.0.0/24"
      mode = "rw"
    },
    {
      vm_identifier = "replace-with-server-identifier"
      mode          = "ro"
    },
  ]
}

output "mount_command" {
  value = vpsie_file_share.data.mount_nfs4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access` (Attributes List) Who may mount the share: 1 to 64 entries, each a server (`vm_identifier`) or a network (`cidr`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `dc_identifier` (String) The datacenter identifier. Changing it replaces the share.
- `name` (String) The share name: 1 to 63 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, not starting with a hyphen. It is the export name and is needed to delete the share. Changing it replaces the share.
- `size_gb` (Number) The share size in GB (10 to 65536). Growing needs quota; shrinking is refused when the share holds more data than the new size.
- `vpc_id` (Number) The numeric id of the VPC the share is served on. The platform does not report it back, so the value in the configuration is kept, and an imported share takes it from the configuration at the next apply. Changing it replaces the share.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the share was created (RFC 3339).
- `gateway_vpc_ip` (String) The address inside the VPC that serves the share, once the share has a gateway.
- `identifier` (String) The share identifier.
- `mount_nfs4` (String) The `mount` command for NFSv4.2 clients, once the share is ready.
- `state` (String) The share state; `ready` once a change has finished.

<a id="nestedatt--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access`

Optional:

- `cidr` (String) An IPv4 network such as `10.0.0.0/24`. Set this or `vm_identifier`.
- `mode` (String) `rw` (the default) or `ro`.
- `vm_identifier` (String) The identifier of a server in the VPC. Set this or `cidr`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A file share can be imported with its identifier; set vpc_id in the configuration, the platform does not report it.
terraform import vpsie_file_share.data <share-identifier>
```
